name: Coin Flip
tagline: Call it in the air — heads or tails?
description: A single cryptographically fair coin toss. Call the landing side correctly to collect a 1.96x payout.
rulesText: Call Heads or Tails before the toss.
The coin is flipped using Web Crypto entropy — an unbiased 50/50 chance.
A correct call returns 1.96x your wager; a wrong call returns nothing.
winCondition: The coin lands on the side you called.
loseCondition: The coin lands on the opposite side.

name: Dice Roll
tagline: Over, under, or call the exact face.
description: Roll a fair six-sided die and predict whether it lands under 4, over 3, or on an exact face.
rulesText: Choose Under (1–3), Over (4–6) or Exact (a single face).
Under and Over are even-money style calls paying 1.96x; Exact pays 5.88x.
Every face has an identical 1-in-6 probability on each independent roll.
winCondition: The rolled face matches your prediction.
loseCondition: The rolled face falls outside your prediction.

name: Lucky Wheel
description: Eight coloured segments with published weights. The landing segment decides your multiplier.
rulesText: Spin the wheel once per round; every segment has a published weight.
The selected segment is decided before the animation begins.
Payouts range from 0x to 5x of your wager.
winCondition: The wheel lands on a segment worth more than 1x.
loseCondition: The wheel lands on a 0x segment, or a segment worth less than your wager.

name: Classic Slots
description: A three-reel slot machine with a fully published paytable, from 777 jackpot down to no match.
rulesText: Pull once per round; the payline combination is drawn from the published table.
The jackpot triple-7 line pays 25x; a cherry pair still returns 1.5x.
No-match spins return nothing.
winCondition: The drawn payline returns more than your wager.
loseCondition: The drawn payline is "No Match".

name: Plinko Drop
tagline: Drop a ball through the peg pyramid.
description: A ball bounces down six rows of pegs into one of seven buckets with published weights and payouts.
rulesText: Drop one ball per round; the destination bucket is chosen from the published weight table.
Edge buckets pay 8.5x but are the least likely; the centre bucket is the most common.
The landing bucket is selected before the bounce animation plays.
winCondition: The ball lands in a bucket paying more than 1x.
loseCondition: The ball lands in a bucket paying less than 1x.

name: High Card Duel
description: Draw a single card against the dealer from a freshly shuffled 52-card deck. Higher rank wins.
rulesText: Both you and the dealer draw one card from a full 52-card deck shuffled per round.
The higher ranked card wins and pays 2x; Ace is high.
Equal ranks are a push and return your wager.
winCondition: Your card outranks the dealer's card.
loseCondition: The dealer's card outranks yours.
tieCondition: Equal ranks push — your wager is returned in full.

name: Roulette Lite
tagline: Back a colour on a 38-pocket wheel.
description: A simplified single-zero style wheel: back a winning pocket at a 2.00x colour payout.
rulesText: Back a colour before the wheel settles.
18 of the 38 pockets pay your colour at 2.00x; the remaining 20 pockets return nothing.
Every spin is independent of all previous spins.
winCondition: The ball settles in a pocket matching your colour.
loseCondition: The ball settles in a pocket belonging to the house.

name: Keno Lite
tagline: Pick a number, watch the draw.
description: Choose one number from 1 to 10. If the single drawn ball matches, you collect 9.5x.
rulesText: Select one number from 1 to 10 before the draw.
One ball is drawn uniformly from the pool of ten numbers.
A match pays 9.5x your wager.
winCondition: The drawn ball matches your chosen number.
loseCondition: The drawn ball is a different number.

name: Bingo Ball
description: Mark one of four squares. The single drawn ball determines whether your square is called.
rulesText: Mark one of four squares on the card before the draw.
Exactly one of the four squares is called, with equal probability.
A called square pays 3.8x your wager.
winCondition: Your marked square is the one called.
loseCondition: A different square is called.

name: Colour Bet
description: Back one of four colours before the draw. A match returns 3.8x your wager.
rulesText: Choose one of four colours before the reveal.
Each colour has an identical 25% chance of being drawn.
A correct call pays 3.8x; an incorrect call pays nothing.
winCondition: The revealed colour matches your choice.
loseCondition: A different colour is revealed.

name: Number Guess
tagline: One in twenty pays nineteen to one.
description: Guess a single number between 1 and 20. A hit returns 19x your wager.
rulesText: Pick one number from 1 to 20 before the reveal.
One number is drawn uniformly from the same range.
An exact hit pays 19x your wager.
winCondition: The drawn number equals your guess.
loseCondition: The drawn number differs from your guess.

name: Marble Draw
tagline: Three red marbles in the bag.
description: Draw one marble from a bag of three red and seven blue. Backing red pays 3.17x.
rulesText: The bag holds ten marbles: three red and seven blue.
One marble is drawn blind and replaced after every round.
Backing red pays 3.17x; backing blue pays nothing.
winCondition: The drawn marble matches the colour you backed.
loseCondition: The drawn marble is the other colour.

name: Coin Trio
tagline: Call all three coins at once.
description: Three independent coin tosses. Call the exact three-coin pattern to win 7.6x.
rulesText: Predict the exact sequence of three independent coin tosses.
Each of the eight possible sequences has an identical 12.5% probability.
A perfect call pays 7.6x your wager.
winCondition: All three tosses match your predicted sequence.
loseCondition: At least one toss differs from your predicted sequence.

name: Wheel of Fortune
description: A five-slice fortune wheel. Landing the golden slice returns 4.8x your wager.
rulesText: The wheel has five equally sized slices; exactly one is golden.
The slice is selected with a uniform draw before the spin animation.
The golden slice pays 4.8x; every plain slice pays nothing.
winCondition: The wheel stops on the golden slice.
loseCondition: The wheel stops on any plain slice.

name: Dice Duel
description: Roll two fair dice and back a total above 7. A winning total returns 2.28x.
rulesText: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled; you back a combined total above 7.
15 of the 36 equally likely outcomes exceed 7; the other 21 do not.
A winning total pays 2.28x your wager.
winCondition: The combined dice total is 8 or higher.
loseCondition: The combined dice total is 7 or lower.

name: Mines
tagline: Reveal gems, dodge the mines, cash out.
description: A 5x5 grid hides three mines. Reveal gems to grow your multiplier, then cash out before you detonate.
rulesText: Three of the twenty-five tiles hide mines; the mine layout is fixed when the round starts.
Each safe reveal multiplies your cash-out value by 25/22 (a 0.98 edge).
Cash out at any time — hitting a mine forfeits the round.
winCondition: You cash out after revealing at least one gem.
loseCondition: You reveal a mine and forfeit the wager.

name: Crash
tagline: Lock in before the curve breaks.
description: A rising multiplier that can break at any moment. Lock in early for a small gain, or push your luck.
rulesText: The multiplier rises from 1.00x and breaks at a predetermined point chosen before the round.
Locking in before the break pays your locked multiplier; otherwise the round is a bust.
The break point is fixed in advance and cannot be influenced by your balance or history.
winCondition: You lock in at a multiplier above 1x before the crash point.
loseCondition: The curve breaks before you lock in.

name: Tower Climb
description: Each floor has a safe step and a collapsing step. Climb once for a 1.9x payout.
rulesText: Each floor presents two steps; exactly one holds your weight.
A safe step pays 1.9x; a collapsing step ends the climb with nothing.
Step placement is decided independently on every floor.
winCondition: Your chosen step holds and you bank the 1.9x return.
loseCondition: The step collapses beneath you.

name: Double or Nothing
description: A closed-form 49% double: win and your wager is doubled, lose and it is gone.

ruleModel.formulaDescription: reward = 2.00 x wager with probability 0.49, otherwise 0

rulesText: The round resolves on a single uniform draw against a fixed 0.49 win threshold.
A win doubles your wager; a loss returns nothing.
The threshold is constant and never adjusted for stake size or prior results.
winCondition: The draw falls below the 0.49 win threshold.
loseCondition: The draw falls at or above the 0.49 win threshold.

name: Bomb Defuse
tagline: Cut one wire out of ten.
description: Three of ten wires are live. Cutting a safe wire returns 3.2x your wager.
rulesText: Ten wires, three of them live. You cut exactly one.
A safe wire pays 3.2x; a live wire ends the round with nothing.
The live wire positions are assigned uniformly at random each round.
winCondition: You cut a wire that is not live.
loseCondition: You cut a live wire.

name: Lava Bridge
description: Choose a plank to cross. The solid plank pays 2.4x; the scorched plank drops you.
rulesText: Five planks span the lava; two are solid and three are scorched.
You step on exactly one plank per crossing.
A solid plank pays 2.4x your wager; a scorched plank pays nothing.
winCondition: You step on a solid plank.
loseCondition: You step on a scorched plank.

name: Tightrope
description: A 60% crossing that returns 1.6x. A lower-variance risk game for steady play.
rulesText: Five of every ten crossings succeed across the long run.
A safe crossing pays 1.6x your wager; a fall pays nothing.
Every attempt is resolved independently.
winCondition: You complete the crossing.
loseCondition: You lose balance and fall.

name: Mystery Box
tagline: Four loot tiers inside every box.
description: Pick a box and unbox one of four published loot tiers, from Common at 0.5x to Legendary at 4x.
rulesText: Choose one of three identical boxes; the loot tier was fixed before you picked.
Four published tiers: Common 0.5x, Rare 1.25x, Epic 2x, Legendary 4x.
Reward-game wins also have a chance to drop a collectible into your inventory.
winCondition: The unboxed tier returns more than your wager (Rare or better).
loseCondition: The unboxed tier returns less than your wager (Common).

name: Treasure Chest
description: A six-chest board with one trapped chest. Opening a safe chest returns a guaranteed multiple.
rulesText: Six chests are laid out; exactly one is trapped. The layout is locked before you choose.
Opening a safe chest pays 1.176x your wager (a 0.98 expected return over the board).
Only one chest may be opened per round.
winCondition: You open a chest that is not trapped.
loseCondition: You open the trapped chest.

name: Scratch Card
description: Scratch a card to reveal its panel. One panel in four is a winning card paying 3.8x.
rulesText: One in four cards is a winner; the card type is assigned before you scratch.
A winning card pays 3.8x your wager.
Every card is independent of all previously scratched cards.
winCondition: You scratch a winning card.
loseCondition: You scratch a blank card.

name: Reward Spin
tagline: A bonus wheel with softer odds.
description: A bonus-flavoured wheel with a 35% hit rate returning 2.7x your wager.
rulesText: 35% of spins land on a bonus slot paying 2.7x.
The remaining 65% land on an empty slot and return nothing.
Slot selection is uniformly random and independent per spin.
winCondition: The wheel stops on a bonus slot.
loseCondition: The wheel stops on an empty slot.

name: Loot Goblin
description: Catch the goblin one time in seven for a 6.3x payout. High variance, published odds.
rulesText: The goblin is caught on 15% of attempts, paying 6.3x your wager.
On the other 85% it escapes and the wager is lost.
Catch probability is fixed and never increases after a string of misses.
winCondition: You catch the goblin.
loseCondition: The goblin escapes.

name: Pinata Smash
description: Take a swing at the pinata. A burst returns 2.1x; a miss returns nothing.
rulesText: 45% of swings burst the pinata, paying 2.1x your wager.
The remaining 55% of swings fail and return nothing.
Swing results are drawn independently every round.
winCondition: Your swing bursts the pinata.
loseCondition: Your swing fails to burst the pinata.

name: Lucky Dip
description: Reach into the dip and pull out a prize token. One token in five pays 4.75x.
rulesText: One token in five is a prize token paying 4.75x your wager.
Tokens are drawn blind and are equally likely on every attempt.
A blank token returns nothing.
winCondition: You draw a prize token.
loseCondition: You draw a blank token.

name: Up or Down
description: Predict whether the next tick rises or falls. A correct call pays 2.00x at a 49% hit rate.
rulesText: Call Up or Down before the next tick is revealed.
The tick direction resolves against a fixed 49% win threshold.
A correct call pays 2.00x; an incorrect call pays nothing.
winCondition: The tick moves in the direction you called.
loseCondition: The tick moves against your call.

name: Over / Under
tagline: Will the total beat the line?
description: Predict whether the generated total finishes over or under the line. 2.04x on a 48% hit.
rulesText: Choose a side of the line before the total is generated.
48% of rounds finish over the line; 52% finish under it.
A correct side pays 2.04x your wager.
winCondition: The generated total lands on the side you chose.
loseCondition: The generated total lands on the opposite side.

name: Bull or Bear
description: Call Bull or Bear on the synthetic index. A correct side returns 2.08x at 47% odds.
rulesText: Declare the session as Bull (rising) or Bear (falling) before it resolves.
47% of sessions resolve in your favour when you back the published side.
A correct side pays 2.08x your wager.
winCondition: The session resolves on the side you declared.
loseCondition: The session resolves on the opposite side.

name: Odd or Even
description: Predict whether the drawn number is odd or even. 1.96x on a 49% hit rate.
rulesText: Call Odd or Even before the number is drawn.
The drawn parity matches your call on 49% of rounds.
A correct parity pays 1.96x your wager.
winCondition: The drawn number has the parity you called.
loseCondition: The drawn number has the opposite parity.

name: High / Low Roll
description: Predict whether a single drawn card ranks 8 or higher, or 7 or lower. Payout is balanced per side.
rulesText: Predict whether one card drawn from a full deck ranks 8+ (High) or 7 or lower (Low).
High covers 7 of 13 ranks and pays 1.82x; Low covers 6 of 13 and pays 2.12x.
Both sides carry the same 0.98 expected return.
winCondition: The drawn card lands on the side you predicted.
loseCondition: The drawn card lands on the opposite side.

name: Arcade 21
description: Classic 21 played from a freshly shuffled deck. Hit and stand against a dealer who stops on 17.
rulesText: You and the dealer each receive two cards from a deck shuffled every round.
You may hit as many times as you like; the dealer stands on all totals of 17 or more.
A natural 21 pays 2.5x, a normal win pays 2x, and equal totals push.
winCondition: Your total beats the dealer's without exceeding 21.
loseCondition: You bust, or the dealer finishes with the higher total.
tieCondition: Equal totals push — your wager is returned in full.

name: Pick a Door
description: Choose one of three doors. The prize was placed behind one of them before you decided.

ruleModel.decisionDescription: Choose one of three doors; the prize position is fixed before the choice is made.

rulesText: The prize is placed behind one of three doors before you choose.
Each door is equally likely to hold the prize.
Opening the prize door pays 2.94x your wager.
winCondition: You open the door hiding the prize.
loseCondition: You open an empty door.

name: Shell Game
description: Track the ball under three cups and make your pick. A correct cup returns 2.94x.

ruleModel.decisionDescription: Choose one of three cups; the ball position is committed before the cups stop moving.

rulesText: The ball is hidden under one of three cups and the cups are shuffled.
The ball position is committed before the shuffle animation plays.
Picking the correct cup pays 2.94x your wager.
winCondition: You pick the cup covering the ball.
loseCondition: You pick an empty cup.

name: Red or Green
description: Press Red or Green. An even-money style call that returns 1.96x when correct.

ruleModel.decisionDescription: Press Red or Green; the result colour is committed before the press registers.

rulesText: Press Red or Green before the result colour is revealed.
Both colours are equally likely on every round.
A matching press pays 1.96x your wager.
winCondition: The revealed colour matches the button you pressed.
loseCondition: The revealed colour is the other button.
